successCriteria: I know 8 on the bottom means a quaver beat.
I can count three quaver beats in a bar of 3/8.
I can say how 3/8 and 3/4 are alike and different.

explanation.text: A bottom number of 8 means the beat is a quaver. In 3/8 there are three quaver beats in every bar.

music.textAlternative: Two bars of 3/8: three beamed quavers, then a crotchet and a quaver.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: 3 beamed together (quaver, quaver, quaver). Bar 2: crotchet, quaver.

explanation.caption: 3/8: three quaver beats. A crotchet fills two of them.
For comparison, 3/4 also has three beats in a bar, but each beat is a crotchet. A bar of 3/8 is shorter: its three beats are only quavers.

explanation.text: So 3/4 and 3/8 both count 1, 2, 3. The bottom number decides how long each count lasts.
Same top number, different bottom number: the same count, but a different beat note.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 3/8: a crotchet and a quaver.

steps: Beat 1 and beat 2 are quavers, so the crotchet fills both of them.
Three quaver beats fill the bar of 3/8.
demonstration.textAlternative: A bar of 3/8 with a crotchet and a quaver: three quaver beats.
